input: Any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must also modify /turn/ply.num to exactly one greater than its current value, and must be signed by that agent's own key and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so a single agent's off-plan move, whether from panic, greed or amnesia, cannot be accepted without near-unanimous agreement and cannot be replayed on a stale ply.
